commentary: The Nifty 50 staged an aggressive 2% thrust to reclaim 25,000 on heavy institutional accumulation, yet a caution gate and breadth score of 52 demand strict O'Neil market-direction discipline. In Stage 2 market environments, explosive index rallies frequently mask narrow internal participation. Stan Weinstein and Jesse Livermore established that sustained uptrends require broad confirming leadership rather than concentrated short-covering rallies. While foreign capital flows heavily into select financial and utility names, traders must practice Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules. We prioritize verified Stage 2 pivots with explosive earnings acceleration, keeping commitments light until market breadth confirms and liquidating quickly if breakouts fail to produce constructive follow-through.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Mark Minervini SEPA, William O'Neil CANSLIM & Stan Weinstein Stage Analysis

360ONE.technical: Price broke above its 20-session pivot on 2.25x average volume with RSI at 59 and intact moving average alignment. However, upward momentum is restrained relative to true market leaders.
360ONE.fundamental: Q2 consolidated PAT slipped 5% YoY to Rs 300 crore while operational revenue rose just 4%, held back by mark-to-market fluctuations. Despite a healthy 16.9% tangible ROE, the bottom-line contraction violates CANSLIM standards.
360ONE.risk: Fails on violation of the 1142.82 stop level; a close below the 50-day moving average mandates immediate loss cutting.

63MOONS.technical: Price forms a double-bottom neckline breakout above its 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. RSI of 56 and positive MACD reflect early bottoming action rather than established Stage 2 momentum.
63MOONS.fundamental: Consolidated operations posted recurring net losses of Rs 28.7 crore in Q2 and Rs 39.7 crore in Q1 FY27. Unreliable bottom-line execution and volatile operating margins disqualify the stock under CANSLIM rules.
63MOONS.risk: Setup invalidates below the 883.03 neckline stop; violation of base support requires swift liquidation to avert deeper Stage 4 declines.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Constructive Stage 2 advance following an orderly pullback to the rising 21-EMA and a high-volume 20-session breakout. RSI at 58 shows strong momentum without overextension.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Consolidated net profit expanded 38% YoY to Rs 1,288 crore on 31% revenue growth, backed by a 32% surge in lending AUM and 73% PBT growth in housing finance. Balance sheet strength confirms institutional accumulation.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Invalidated if price breaches the 391.17 stop; failure to hold the rising 21-EMA signals distribution and demands an immediate exit.

ABSLNN50ET.technical: Index instrument cleared a 20-session high on 1.26x volume, sustaining clean positioning above rising 21, 50, and 200 moving averages with RSI at 66 reflecting broad large-cap momentum.
ABSLNN50ET.risk: Thesis invalidates on a breakdown below 76.15; breach of intermediate moving average support dictates a disciplined rule-based exit.

ADANIENSOL.technical: Premier Stage 2 momentum leader breaking out to new 20-session highs. Price trades firmly above upward-trending 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, reinforced by RSI at 60 and positive MACD.
ADANIENSOL.fundamental: Stellar CANSLIM profile as Q2 operational revenue surged 53% YoY and PAT vaulted 148% to Rs 1,364 crore, driven by smart metering and high-margin energy solutions. Massive utility cash flows support capital expenditure debt.
ADANIENSOL.risk: Violated on a drop below the 1575.77 pivot stop; closing beneath the 50-day moving average triggers instant capital preservation.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Stage 2 breakout clearing a 20-session consolidation high above ascending 21, 50, and 200 moving averages. RSI of 63 and bullish MACD confirm accumulation.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Q2 revenue from power supply jumped 42% YoY with a remarkable 92% EBITDA margin. However, rising finance costs constrained net profit growth to 16%, failing O'Neil's 25% minimum EPS growth threshold.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Exit immediately on a breach of the 1326.34 stop level, which signals an institutional bull trap at range highs.
